items.title: IBM公布首個能執行主機及Arm應用的雙架構晶片
items.summary: IBM週一在Hot Chips大會上發布雙架構處理器（Dual-Architecture Processor），是首個能讓Arm原生Linux環境與z/OS及Linux on IBM Z同時執行的次世代處理平臺。 這款晶片是今年4月IBM和Arm宣布合作的結果。未來將用於IBM Z主機與LinuxONE系統上。

items.title: 人形機器人首度打破100米及400米短跑人類紀錄
items.summary: 第二屆世界人形機器人運動會上周六（8/22）在北京開幕，由北京人形機器人創新中心所研發的天工Ultra在100米預賽跑出9.39秒的成績，超越Usain Bolt保持的9.58秒人類男子百米世界紀錄；隔天同款天工Ultra參加400米大型組決賽，再以38.15秒奪冠，亦快於南非選手Wayde van Niekerk於2016年里約奧運所創下的43.03秒紀錄。這是首次有人形機器人在短跑上贏過人類世界紀錄。

items.title: Microsoft 365免費授權用戶傳被刪除OneDrive資料，影響規模傳達17.1萬個非營利組織
items.summary: Slate報導，微軟將Microsoft 365部分免費授權方案用戶資料刪除。相關影響規模目前主要來自個案當事人轉述微軟客服說法，尚非微軟正式公布的受影響組織數。

items.title: Android銀行木馬ToxicPanda 2.0擴大攻擊，瞄準349款金融應用
items.summary: 行動資安業者Zimperium發現新版Android銀行木馬ToxicPanda 2.0，攻擊者可透過167種遠端指令控制受感染手機，並針對分布在16國的349款銀行、金融、電子錢包及加密貨幣應用，顯示仿冒登入或交易畫面，竊取帳密與個人識別碼（PIN）。惡意程式還能偽造Android鎖定畫面，取得手機解鎖PIN碼、圖形或密碼。

items.title: 中國迷你電腦品牌GEEKOM舊版驅動套件遭判定含Asruex木馬，涉及6款AMD機種
items.summary: 中國迷你電腦品牌GEEKOM證實，舊版官方支援頁曾提供一個遭多個安全掃描服務判定為惡意程式的網路驅動程式安裝檔，其中部分掃描結果將其辨識為Asruex木馬。該套件適用於A7、A8、AE7、AE8、AX7 Pro及AX8 Pro等6款AMD迷你電腦。原廠已下架相關檔案，並強調問題只涉及使用者自行下載的驅動程式套件，出廠預載的Windows系統不受影響。

items.title: 美國司法部與TikTok、ByteDance兒童隱私訴訟以4億美元和解
items.summary: 美國司法部宣布，TikTok、母公司ByteDance及關係企業同意支付4億美元，和解2024年提出的兒童隱私訴訟。案件涉及《兒童線上隱私保護法》（COPPA），美國政府指控TikTok在未取得家長同意下蒐集及保存13歲以下兒童的個人資料。司法部表示，本案追償金額位居COPPA案件歷來前列。

items.title: fix: /models stops working after an unrelated config edit and never r…
items.summary: fix: /models stops working after an unrelated config edit and never recovers (#128608) * fix: /models stops working after an unrelated config edit and never recovers A config transaction whose reload plan is empty publishes the new runtime config but never advances the prepared model owner's config stamp. Owners are stamped with a hash of the whole config, so a key with no bearing on models leaves every strict-policy catalog read rejected for the life of the gateway process. Advance the model-neutral config stamp in place on no-op publications instead of rebuilding the prepared generation, which the planner has already determined is unnecessary. Existing leases keep their immutable snapshot, auth bindings carry onto the restamped snapshot, pending builds restamp at commit, and read-only owners are untouched. Deferred startup publication now resolves its config inside the serialized refresh so a no-op commit landing mid-startup cannot publish an already-stale stamp. Related: #128515 Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 * fix(gateway): rebuild prepared owners from the committed runtime config The no-op commit path resolves secrets and commits prepared.config, but the rebuild that follows used the source-derived candidate. Where resolution returns a different object -- secrets.providers.* edits, which are exactly the changes that must rebuild rather than restamp -- the rebuilt owner carries an identity no reader supplies, so every strict catalog read rejects it and the failure this change removes reappears on its own fallback path. Reuse the config the runtime-commit hook already receives, cleared per transaction so a rebuild cannot inherit one committed by an earlier one. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 * test(gateway): cover the resolved-config auth rewarm The ownership scenario returned the config secrets activation received, so a rebuild against the source candidate looked correct. Let activation resolve to a distinct object and assert by identity which config the rebuild used -- deep equality matches either object and proves nothing. Fails without the committed-config selection, passes with it. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 * fix(gateway): preserve prepared runtime options on auth rewarm --------- Co-authored-by: Marvinthebored Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
